accountBinding: Upload practice media through the normal authenticated Studio entry. The starter is fresh and belongs to that account. This recipe transfers no owner, Storage path, cloud allowance or completed render.

steps.title: Start with normal behaviour
steps.control: Choose videos; Open Creator Studio; Trim start to here; Trim end to here
steps.why: Four seconds establish the ordinary conversion.

steps.title: Add the boundary recording
steps.control: Import project videos; Add to sequence
steps.value: boundary-input.mp4; programme 7 s → trim start; programme 8 s → trim end (source 3–7 s)
steps.why: The original includes 0 and 255. Keep the maximum-value result readable.

steps.title: Add rejection evidence
steps.control: Import project videos; Add to sequence
steps.value: invalid-input.mp4; programme 9 s → trim start; programme 12 s → trim end (source 1–5 s)
steps.why: Show the 256 validation message. Do not label this as a successful conversion.

steps.title: Read the timeline
steps.why: Order communicates an argument. Dragging a source into the library alone does not place it in the programme.

steps.title: Review every cut
steps.value: Inspect just before and after 4 s and 8 s
steps.why: Watch for hidden output, missing validation and incorrect source timing.

steps.title: Save and export
steps.why: A twelve-second summary can accompany a longer written test table.
